Reviewer: m3 pool job review-4206, claude-fable-5-2, mkinney / seat `.claude-team2`; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: the review is clean, but the PR conflicts with `main`.** There are no blockers in the code. The label is `conflicts`. The PR stays a draft until its parent #4164 merges and this branch is refreshed at merge time.

Ownership record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4206#issuecomment-7200793682

## Scope of this review

- The PR is stacked on #4164 (head `201b942e4`). I reviewed the two commits above that head: `9d6ebbd62` and `b3541f715`.
- This review does not review #4164. Files in the PR diff that belong to #4164 (`heidenhain.cps`, `heidenhain-klartext.cps`, `machine_controller.rs`, `docs/decisions/4087-tool-table-max.md`) are not in its scope.
- Tier: the PR adds a refusal in the post engine. It does not change the text of a program that posts. I ran the mutations of the safety tier.

## What is good

- The refusal is in the engine, before a script hook runs (`crates/post/src/post/engine.rs:135`). Each post gets it, and a script error cannot hide it.
- A malformed key is refused by name in the machine reader and in the raw engine input (`crates/post/src/machine/installation.rs:152`). It is not read as "no limit".
- The mirror carries the key, so the app path and the raw file path give the same result. The pinning test runs the two paths for the two Heidenhain posts.
- A machine without the key keeps the limit of the post. A key above the limit of the post does not raise it. A test pins the two cases.
- There is no `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!()` in the new source code. The new test file has a provenance line and names its crate.
- The body has `Changelog:`, `Fixes #4088`, the "Goldens moved" section and a decision file.

## Results, built locally on host m3

Tree: PR head `b3541f715` merged with `upstream/main` `773736856`. The merge has one conflict (see "Conflict"). I resolved it locally to keep the two sides. That commit is for the review only and is not pushed.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate test preset_rows --crate post --binary heidenhain_cycles` | green, 4 tests |
| Quick plan (`--base upstream/main`), post steps: `post build`, `post suites: lib` and 131 integration suites | 132 suites green, 1283 passed, 0 failed |
| Quick plan, `app build (--no-run)` | green |
| Quick plan, 210 app suites, one `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test <suite>` for each | 210 green, 1758 passed, 0 failed, 42 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo check --tests -p camcraft-ui` | clean |

- The app suites include `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `golden_cl`, `klartext_builtin`, `machine_controller`, `first_part_programs` and `project_roundtrip`.
- The app suites ran by direct `cargo test` calls, because one gate call for all of them is longer than the 10-minute limit of this host. The suite list is the list of the quick plan.
- Heavy lanes: not run. No heavy record names this head. The PR is a `P3` and the diff adds a refusal only.

Extra suites run: none are owed. The diff changes no file under `testdata/`, no fixture directory and no import code.

## Mutations (each one red, then restored and green)

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| M1: the engine guard is disabled (`engine.rs`) | red: `heidenhain_posts_refuse_a_preset_above_the_machine_preset_table` |
| M2: the mirror does not write the key (`machine_installation.rs`) | red: the same test, on the mirrored input |
| M3: the guard is `n > max + 1` (`work_offset.rs`) | red: the same test |
| M4: the reader accepts 0 (`installation.rs`) | red: `a_malformed_work_offset_max_is_refused_by_name` |

After the last restore, the three `preset_rows` tests are green and `git status` shows no change.

## Goldens

The two commits change no `*.nc`, `*.cl`, `*.cnc`, `examples/catalog/**` or snapshot PNG file. This agrees with "Goldens moved: None" in the body.

## Conflict

- `crates/post/src/post/machine_installation.rs`, in `script_props`: the branch adds the `toolNumberMax` block (#4164, #4087) where `main` adds the `arcTolerance` block.
- The two sides add different lines. To keep the two blocks is sufficient. All results above are on that resolution.
- The conflict is in the lines of #4164, not in the lines of this PR. A refresh of #4164 removes it.
- `upstream/main` moved to `763a1dbff` during this review. The results are for `773736856`.

## Requested before merge

None in the code.

## Questions and notes (not blocking)

1. Merge order: #4164 is open and has the `conflicts` label. This PR cannot merge before it. Retarget and refresh by AGENTS.md "Overlapping issues stack".
2. `Fixes #4088` closes the issue at merge. The first "Done means" item of the issue (the row count is confirmed at the control) is not done, and the body says so. The maintainer decides if the issue stays open for that check or if a follow-up issue holds it.
3. File length: `crates/post/src/machine/def.rs` (437 lines) and `crates/post/src/machine/parse.rs` (440 lines) were above 400 lines before this PR. They grow by 4 lines and 1 line. A split can be a `P7` follow-up.
4. The setup page still offers work offsets up to the limit of the post. The body names this as a possible follow-up. I recommend a `P7` issue for it after the merge.
5. The value 5 comes from the 2008 delivery CD. If the control has more rows, the refusal has a workaround: raise the key in the machine file. The machine description says this.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
